paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the exact match (EM) performance (%) of three different models as a function of the number of turns of inner monologue, ranging from 0 to 6, on the HotPotQA dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Turns of Inner Monologue" and uses a linear scale with integer tick marks from 0 to 6, spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "EM (%)" and spans from 0 to 50, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 10. The red line with 'x' markers represents SIM-RAG with an Oracle Critic, starting at approximately 20% EM at 0 turns and increasing steadily to about 46% at 6 turns, showing a consistent upward trend. The blue line with 'x' markers corresponds to SIM-RAG (lite), beginning at approximately 15% EM at 0 turns and rising to around 30% at 6 turns, also exhibiting a gradual increase. The green line with 'x' markers denotes Naive Gen, which remains flat at approximately 20% EM across all turns, indicating no improvement with additional inner monologue turns.
